title: Age of Identity Evidence and the Starting Point of a Personal Sender Account Refresh Interval
content:
When a Personal Sender Account is moved up a level, the refresh interval to its next periodic review is counted from a starting point selected from the identity evidence every level relies on — the government photo ID and the selfie. The refresh interval is the risk-weighted refresh interval counted from that starting point, that is, the risk-weighted refresh interval less the whole calendar months already run from that starting point to the upgrade date.

**Evidence-age step.**

1. When the latest accepted government photo ID was accepted 18 or more whole calendar months before the upgrade date, the interval runs from the date that ID was accepted.
2. When that ID was accepted fewer than 18 months before, but the latest accepted selfie was accepted 18 or more months before, the interval runs from the date that selfie was accepted.
3. Otherwise the interval runs from the upgrade date, and no month has yet run.

## Reading the records

The date a document was accepted is the review date of its review with the outcome accepted. The latest accepted government ID is the government ID whose accepted review is most recent; the same holds for the selfie. Whole calendar months are counted from that acceptance date to the upgrade date.

## Decision table

| Latest accepted government ID accepted | Latest accepted selfie accepted | Interval runs from | Months already run |
|---|---|---|---|
| 18 or more whole months before the upgrade | any time | the ID's acceptance date | the whole months from the ID's acceptance to the upgrade |
| fewer than 18 months before | 18 or more whole months before | the selfie's acceptance date | the whole months from the selfie's acceptance to the upgrade |
| fewer than 18 months before | fewer than 18 months before | the upgrade date | 0 |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A risk-weighted refresh interval of 30 months; the latest accepted government ID was accepted 20 whole months before the upgrade date. The interval runs from the ID's acceptance date: 30 months less the 20 months already run leaves 10 months, so the next periodic review falls due 10 calendar months after the upgrade date. Had the ID been accepted 17 months before and the selfie 19 months before, the interval would run from the selfie's acceptance and 11 months would remain. Had both been accepted fewer than 18 months before, the full 30 months would run from the upgrade date.
